Definition: from G3319 and G5109; a partition (figuratively):--middle wall.
BiblicalUsage: Mesotoichon is the middle wall, the partition between Jew and Gentile. Ephesians 2:14 says Christ is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wall is down because Christ is the peace: the partition fell when He made the two into one.
